cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Our first dinner since the breakup, and you still groan at my waiter joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. You remembered. We've still got our little traditions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we eat in silence? I don't want another awful joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still know how to ask me for what you need. I'll order dessert so we have time.

mechanism: A grants silence as a privileged form of continued connection, interpreting even B request to stop the jokes as proof their bond survives.
confusable: D20 celebrates bad news generally; D92 must read each awkward interaction as evidence of this particular connection.
comparison: A post-breakup dinner and silence differ from repeated canceled Fridays and a release from scheduling.
seedUse: Use D92-a remembered bad joke and B silence request; let approving that request become A evidence of intimacy.
